title: Absolutely minimising Lipschitz extensions between Hilbert spaces
summary: Every Lipschitz map from a closed subset of a real Hilbert space into a real Hilbert space has an absolutely minimising Lipschitz extension: an extension whose Lipschitz constant on every open subset of the complement, bounded or not, equals the Lipschitz constant of its restriction to the boundary of that subset. Neither space need be separable. This answers a question of Naor and Sheffield.
